# transforms to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transformsTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a reference frame to another frame it can be mathematically transformed to.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md) from [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare that one frame can be mathematically transformed to another (e.g. liftover, datum conversion).

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the transform matrix or executing the conversion in the graph — the transform is performed by an external solver ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md) between frames and let [`gmeow:frameSolver`](gmeow-frameSolver.md) name the method; the computation stays out of the OWL core.

- [`gmeow:referenceFrameFK5`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameFK5.md) [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameICRS`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameICRS.md).
